faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Assistant position at IIT Madras is 02 September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Assistant role, candidates must possess a post-graduate degree in any discipline. Prior research experience is preferred, and a background in linguistics or Cognitive Science is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the IIT Madras Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of eligible candidates, followed by a test or interview, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIT Madras Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIT Madras or the direct application link provided. Ensure all details are accurate and required documents are uploaded.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position at IIT Madras is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Madras located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or relaxations. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for detailed information on age criteria.
